rows.en: (Now, what should I buy at Folmo today...)

I just came to do a little shopping.
What are you up to, Luis-san?

Whoa, whoa, just how fresh are you?
You're killin' me... Can't you tell by looking?
It's a gig! A G-I-G!

Huh!?
You do street concerts, Luis-san?

Oh YES!
Live is my LIFE!!

The best way to get my overflowing passion
across... is song!
Now let's see if we can move a mountain!!
(M-Move a mountain...?)

The crowd's picking up, perfect timing.
Time to get started!
Since you're here, stick around and listen.
Okay, then I'll do that.

No, wait...
You look like just listening won't cut it for you.

I know, you sing with me!
Let's move that mountain together!!

Huh!?
Wait, you can't just spring that on me......

Don't be shy!
No need to be embarrassed, it's your debut!
rows.notes: 'Don't be shy!' is English in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Ahh, ahh, mic check, one, two...
All right, let's start!!
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat!!
Ugh... That was so embarrassing......
I've seen your passion, loud and clear...
Luis-san...
It wasn't bad...

But! However!!!
That's not enough to move the mountain
called Luis Fernando!

All right, one more song!
Follow me!!!

(Ugh... Please, give me a break already......
Luis-san...)

(I came to Folmo, but there's nothing
in particular to do. Hmm, what should I do...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
Is he about to do a gig or something?)
(Huh? He went off somewhere...)

(Wait, why am I disappointed...?
Was I looking forward to Luis-san's show?)

(Well, even if I was, I'd rather not
join in myself ever again...)

(I came to Folmo, but there's nothing
in particular to do. Hmm, what should I do...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
Is he about to do a gig or something?)

(Wait, why am I disappointed...?
Was I looking forward to Luis-san's show?)

(Okay, classes are over,
so I guess I'll head home soon...)

Well, I'm a Mihoshi student, so...
What are you doing here, Luis-san?

Got nostalgic for this thing called school.
Came to soak in some memories for a bit.
Couldn't help it...
Huh? Did you graduate from Mihoshi, Luis-san?
The answer is NO, Fresh Boy.
(Huh! Oh, s-so he didn't...)

The school I went to was called
Dalmatian High School, on planet Eden.
Huh, is that right.

Don't know why, but I was famous
in high school. Back then, I got called
by a nickname I never saw coming.

(Well, it wouldn't be strange for Luis-san
to be famous, in more ways than one...)
What kind of nickname was it?
Heh, you must've heard it too.
The Hummingbird of Dalmatian High School...
...is me!

(Yeah, never heard it...
That nickname......)

High school life is one of life's precious
memories. Enjoy every day to the fullest
so you have no regrets, OK?

Guess I got a little too lost in nostalgia.
Not like me at all...

Guess I'll head home.
See ya.
Okay, see you later.

(High school life is one of life's precious
memories, huh... I'll do my best
to make them all good ones!)

(Still, Luis-san... he's always just hanging
around inside the school like it's normal.
Isn't that a problem...?)

Well, I'm a Mihoshi student, so...
What are you doing here, Luis-san?
The answer is NO, Fresh Girl.

(Well, it wouldn't be strange for Luis-san
to be famous, in more ways than one...)
What kind of nickname was it?

(High school life is one of life's precious
memories, huh... I'll do my best
to make them all good ones!)

(Phew, today's classes were exhausting.
I just want to go home and sleep...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
He's got kind of a wistful look...
Is he remembering the old days again?)

Ahh, I'm starving.
All right, let's go grab a chili dog!

(So he was just hungry...
Sigh... Guess I'll go home too...)

(Phew, today's classes were exhausting.
I just want to go home and sleep...)

(Oh, it's Luis-san.
He's got kind of a wistful look...
Is he remembering the old days again?)

(So he was just hungry...
Sigh... Guess I'll go home too......)
